title: torso poke-through calibration — bone-classified, upper garment, bind pose

method.skinDefinition: visible skin primitive only (material ^mpfb_skin_); openclinxr_hidden_* are non-drawing and excluded
method.dominantBoneRule: highest WEIGHTS_0 weight, first-wins ties — same rule as _bone_dominant_vertex_indices (body_param_stage.py:741)
method.envelope: per-cell max garment radius over 36 angle buckets x 16mm height bands, around the garment XZ centroid
method.bound: none — this slice deliberately plants no poke-through threshold; a later slice calibrates one against these numbers

actors.mechanism: 1 torso-dominant skin vertices sit 2.7 mm median (worst 2.7 mm) beyond the garment envelope; 0 of 1 are at garment free edges (single-height collar/hem rim cells, densest at -53°, 430 mm above the hem) — no fabric-covered cell shows skin beyond the envelope; whether sub-centimetre rim adjacency renders is not determined here (hide-mask interaction is NOT TESTED in the issue) and matters for the bound

4 torso-dominant skin vertices sit 19.5 mm median (worst 22.6 mm) beyond the garment envelope; all are at garment free edges (single-height collar/hem rim cells, densest at 139°, 386 mm above the hem) — no fabric-covered cell shows skin beyond the envelope; whether sub-centimetre rim adjacency renders is not determined here (hide-mask interaction is NOT TESTED in the issue) and matters for the bound
zero torso-dominant skin vertices beyond the upper garment's radial envelope — no drawn skin outside the garment silhouette detected at bind pose
